status: Design fixed after archive feasibility checks and selected illustrative revisions; not an untouched-data preregistration. No registration has been submitted.
working_title: When Do Migration Statistics Become Reliable? Release Revisions and Monitoring Stability in New Zealand and Australia
estimand: Stability of publicly released estimates relative to a fixed-age published reference, not error relative to unobserved true migration.
primary_substantive_flow: Net migration; arrivals and departures explain its revision behavior.

matched_country_comparison.new_zealand_aggregation: Sum the three original monthly counts within one common publication vintage. Never combine months from different vintages. No quarterly standard error inferred from marginal monthly standard errors.
matched_country_comparison.availability_gate: Verify actual release timestamps and availability at every prescribed cutoff before calculating outcomes. Report any attrition and causes; never move a cutoff to obtain a preferred result.

australia_extended.role: Longer within-country context; not used to rank countries against different reference years.

time_alignment.cutoff: End of the calendar day h calendar months after the reference-period end, using month-end-preserving arithmetic.
time_alignment.as_of_rule: Latest archived publication actually issued on or before the cutoff. No interpolation, use of future releases, or replacement by a newer download.
time_alignment.initial_release: Also describe each country's first publication separately, with its actual publication delay. This is a product comparison, not a comparison at equal information age.
time_alignment.missing: Unavailable is missing, never zero. Report availability by age. Use a balanced matched cohort for the main age profile.
time_alignment.within_release_replacement: If historical corrections replaced an archive file, label the available archive edition; do not assert unverified first-day byte identity.

primary.rule: Published estimate available as of reference end plus 18 calendar months, regardless of its official provisional/final label. Record that label separately when documented.
primary.reason: Common elapsed time and proximity to both systems' regular maturation; this is explicitly a fixed-age reference rather than certified final truth.

sensitivity.role: Level-revision sensitivity only, evaluated against the 18-month specification on identical eligible cohorts. Directional sensitivity at 24 months requires exact prior-year counts in the same vintage and is otherwise omitted and disclosed.

references.late_corrections: Show separately documented post-final corrections, particularly in NZ, using the frozen latest vintage. These case studies are not a replacement for the primary reference.

analysis_modules.revision_sign: R_f(t,h) = Y_f(t,18) - Y_f(t,h); positive means later upward revision.
analysis_modules.primary_scale: G_t = A_t(18) + D_t(18); use R_f/G_t for cross-country and component comparisons.
analysis_modules.additional_flow_metric: For arrivals and departures, report absolute revision divided by that flow's reference count when positive. Never divide net migration revision by net migration. Do not silently trim low-volume periods.

analysis_modules.primary_net_requirement: At least 90% of reference periods have absolute net revision no greater than 2% of reference gross flow.
analysis_modules.component_requirement: For each positive gross flow, separately report 5% of its own reference count at 90% attainment; these component thresholds do not imply comparable stringency to the net threshold.
analysis_modules.qualification_rule: Earliest tested age at which the requirement holds and remains satisfied at all later tested ages through 15 months. If none qualifies, report not attained before the 18-month reference. Never include the reference itself as evidence of successful early qualification.
analysis_modules.interpretation: All thresholds are pre-analysis illustrative user requirements, not official standards or guaranteed future performance. Show empirical counts, uncertainty, and the whole grid; never select a preferred threshold after seeing results.

analysis_modules.primary_change: Current quarter minus the same quarter of the preceding year, with both values taken from the same publication vintage. Compare with the corresponding same-vintage change in the 18-month reference publication.
primary_outputs: conditional reversal rates for initially rising and initially falling migration
analysis_modules.material_change_check: Three categories using change in net migration divided by current-period gross flow from the same vintage: less than -1%, within [-1%,1%], greater than 1%.
analysis_modules.interpretation: Statistical monitoring statements, not demonstrated political or causal effects. No fitted seasonal adjustment and no random-guess accuracy test.

analysis_modules.scale_rule: For the scaled identity, divide all three revisions of a given reference period by the same G_t before squaring.
analysis_modules.checks: Use identical periods and vintages. Record any rounding residual in published net figures; never force the identity by silently overwriting a published series.
analysis_modules.claim_limit: Arithmetic decomposition of net revision, not causal attribution to production methods.

analysis_modules.frequency: monthly; retain published year-ended intervals as a secondary separate series if needed
analysis_modules.interval: Published 95% interval, or estimate plus/minus 1.96 times archived standard error where documented; do not mix interval levels.
metrics: large misses with documented revision events
analysis_modules.interpretation: Empirical usefulness for subsequent published references. These are model-uncertainty intervals, so revision coverage is not automatically a test of the producer's nominal inferential claim.
analysis_modules.no_abs_invention: No official ABS uncertainty intervals are imputed. No summation of monthly standard errors to produce quarterly intervals.

inference.orientation: Estimation and documented historical frequencies, not a large family of significance tests.
inference.resampling_unit: Entire reference-period vintage path, retaining all flows and ages; matched countries are resampled together for common-period differences.
inference.procedure: Stationary block bootstrap, 10000 replicates, fixed seed 20261018.
inference.intervals: Pointwise 95% intervals, clearly distinguished from simultaneous confidence bands or forecast intervals.
inference.limits: Weak-dependence/stationarity assumptions are not guaranteed across pandemic or methods breaks. With only 25 matched quarters, resampling is an uncertainty sensitivity, not a certification of future reliability. No causal country ranking and no significance claims from an unadjusted grid.

robustness: 18 versus 24 month references on matched cohorts
All periods retained in primary estimates; pandemic-window and documented-method-break summaries kept descriptive
Leave-one-calendar-year-out influence analysis without retuning thresholds
Documented late corrections separately from regular maturation
Report low gross-volume periods and normalization sensitivity rather than winsorizing them
not_in_current_core: New ML, Bayesian, or many-model prediction tournament
Causal percentage attribution of revisions to data maturity versus method changes without counterfactual reprocessing
Automatic transfer of stability thresholds between migration definitions
Out-of-sample revision correction claimed from in-sample residuals

publication_strategy.contribution: Reproducible release-vintage evidence linking revision size to stability of monitoring statements and to cancellation between gross-flow revisions.
publication_strategy.quartile_note: Verify the intended ranking system, subject category and year directly before choosing the submission journal. No current quartile is certified by this protocol.
publication_strategy.claim_limits: No first-ever or Q1/Q2 acceptance guarantee. Compare explicitly with ONS 2025 migration revision/stability work and established real-time data literature.
publication_strategy.release_plan: Publish source manifest, extraction code, audit checks, and permitted vintage panel with clear versioning.

next_execution: Construct and validate actual-date as-of panels and sample attrition before any main outcome tables. Log all subsequent protocol changes with reasons.
